source_row.rationale: Guaifenesin is an expectorant that works by thinning and loosening respiratory secretions (reducing their viscosity), making coughs more productive and easier to clear — a different mechanism and purpose from cough suppressants (antitussives) like dextromethorphan, which work by suppressing the cough reflex itself.
